beats.subtitle: 달에도 골프공이 있다?
beats.visual: Close lunar dust with a white dimpled golf ball at frame right and an empty lower central area.
beats.motion: Slow 2.5D push-in, separate foreground dust from distant horizon; reveal the ball before the caption settles.

beats.narration: 천구백칠십일 년, 달에 도착한 우주비행사 앨런 셰퍼드.
beats.subtitle:
1971년 2월 6일
아폴로 14호 · 앨런 셰퍼드
beats.visual: Wide lunar plate; a generic faceless astronaut is a separate foreground layer.
beats.motion: Gentle lateral parallax with a brief date reveal, followed by the name; keep the horizon stable.

beats.narration: 그는 시료 채취 도구에 육 번 아이언 헤드를 끼웠죠.
beats.subtitle: 시료 채취 도구 + 6번 아이언
beats.visual: Low-angle S3 iron-tool plate, showing the recognizable lofted iron face, hosel and long metallic handle.
beats.motion: Rack visual attention from the shaft toward the head with a modest crop push; add two separate caption labels rather than engravings.

beats.narration: 두꺼운 우주복 탓에 몸을 비틀기도 어려웠지만, 한 손으로 휘둘렀습니다.
beats.subtitle:
두꺼운 우주복 때문에
한 손으로 스윙
beats.visual: Generic astronaut composited over the lunar plate, using one hand on the long tool; face remains obscured.
beats.motion: One restrained swing gesture with separate arm/tool layers and slight body pivot. This is an illustrative gesture, not frame-accurate reenactment.

beats.narration: 그날, 골프공 두 개가 달의 먼지 위를 날아갔죠.
beats.subtitle: 달에서 친 골프공, 두 개
beats.visual: Two separate illustrative ball inserts, followed by two small balls resting apart on lunar dust.
beats.motion: Show the balls sequentially with a cut or dissolve between them; use short stylized arcs without distance ticks or a shared impact moment.

beats.narration: 달의 중력은 지구의 약 육분의 일. 장소부터 다른 골프였습니다.
beats.subtitle: 달의 중력 ≈ 지구의 1/6
beats.visual: Lunar plate with the ball and its grounded shadow; a clean gravity comparison appears as a video overlay.
beats.motion: Ease to a still frame; animate a simple six-to-one proportion diagram without implying a sixfold shot distance.

beats.narration: 그리고 그 골프공 두 개는, 지금도 달에 남아 있습니다.
beats.subtitle:
그 골프공 두 개는
지금도 달에 있습니다
beats.visual: A pair of golf balls on quiet lunar dust with the generic astronaut absent from frame.
beats.motion: Very slow pull-back; let the last frame and caption hold for approximately one second after the final syllable if narration length permits.

claims.moon_golf: Alan Shepard played golf on the Moon during Apollo 14.
claims.mission_and_date: Apollo 14 commander Alan Shepard struck golf balls on the lunar surface on 1971-02-06.
claims.modified_tool: A six-iron head was attached to a lunar sampling-tool handle.
claims.one_handed: The bulky pressure suit constrained movement, and he swung one-handed.
claims.two_balls: He hit two golf balls; this does not specify two swings or any measured distance.
claims.gravity: Lunar surface gravity is approximately one sixth of Earth's.
claims.remain_on_moon: The two golf balls were left on the Moon.

source_note: Known NASA reference URLs, not live-fetched in this session. They are not represented as newly verified source content.
